seoTitle: Christmas Hampers 2026 UK: 9 Compared by Price
title: Christmas hampers 2026 UK: nine compared, from £34 to £150
description: Christmas hampers 2026 compared: Tesco, John Lewis, Fortnum's, Hotel Chocolat and more, with prices, contents and order deadlines checked 2 November.
intro:
**The best-value Christmas hamper we've found this year is John Lewis's Christmas Delights at £40: six treats including mulled wine, in stock now with free click and collect.** On a tighter budget, Tesco's Finest hamper with Prosecco is £35 (£30 with Clubcard), and for a big gift, the Waitrose No.1 Golden hamper at £150 includes three bottles of wine.

Every price below was checked on 2 November 2026. Hampers sell out rather than get cheaper, and several popular ones already have, so we've included order deadlines too.

body:
## How to choose a Christmas hamper

A hamper is mostly packaging plus a handful of treats, so the price per item varies a lot. Before you buy, check:

- **What's actually inside.** Count the items and note the sizes. A hamper with three full bottles of wine (like the Waitrose No.1) is far better value than one padded out with tiny jars and straw.
- **Alcohol or not.** Many hampers include wine or Prosecco. For anyone who doesn't drink, for a workplace, or for a family with young children, pick one without, like Fortnum's Christmas Treat hamper or a chocolate collection.
- **Dietary needs.** Vegan and gluten-free hampers are now common at John Lewis and Hampers.com. Still read the full contents list on the page, as "free from" labels rarely cover every allergen.
- **The basket.** Wicker baskets look good and can be reused; boxes are cheaper and easier to post. If the hamper is going straight onto your own table, don't pay extra for the basket.
- **Delivery.** Check whether delivery is free and whether you can choose the day. A hamper sitting on a doorstep or with a neighbour for a week is a poor gift, especially with fresh cheese.

## Which hamper for which budget?

**Under £40:** Tesco's Finest hamper (£35, or £30 with Clubcard) and Hampers.com's Little Taste of Christmas (£34) are the cheapest well-known options. Tesco's only comes with a grocery order, so it suits your own Christmas or someone you'll see. Virginia Hayward also lists smaller boxes from around £22.

**£40–£75:** the sweet spot. John Lewis's Christmas Delights (£40) is the safest choice, and Hotel Chocolat's family collection (£60) suits chocolate lovers. Fortnum's Merrymaker's and Taste of Fortnum's hampers are £75 if the name matters.

**£100 and up:** the Waitrose No.1 Golden hamper (£150) packs in the most food and drink for the money. Fortnum's hampers carry the brand, but you pay for it: its £120 Christmas Treat hamper has seven items against Waitrose's thirteen.

## Are hampers cheaper on Black Friday?

Rarely. Black Friday is on **Friday 27 November 2026** ([see every retailer's dates](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/)), but none of the retailers we checked has announced hamper discounts, and we found no sign that big-name hampers are usually cut. Hampers sell out instead: several John Lewis, Fine Food Specialist and Hampers.com options are already gone. The real savings are discount codes (Hampers.com offers 10% off a first order for signing up to emails, and John Lewis gives 10% off through its app) and free delivery thresholds.

## Order deadlines

Don't leave it to the last week. Dates we found:

- **Tesco Festive Food to Order:** order by 14 December, for delivery or collection 20–24 December.
- **Virginia Hayward:** order by 2pm on 23 December for Christmas Eve delivery on the UK mainland (16 December for the Highlands and Islands).
- **Fine Food Specialist:** last delivery 23 December.
- **John Lewis:** fresh hampers deliver from 3 or 15 December depending on the line.

For more present ideas, see our [Christmas gifts for her under £50](/guides/christmas-gifts-for-her-under-50/) and [Secret Santa gifts under £10](/guides/secret-santa-gifts-under-10/), or browse all our [Christmas gift guides](/christmas-gifts/).

### What's the best Christmas hamper for the money?

For most people, John Lewis's Christmas Delights at £40. For a bigger budget, the Waitrose No.1 Golden hamper at £150 has more food and wine than rivals at the same price.

### When should I order a Christmas hamper?

As soon as you've chosen. Popular hampers sell out from early November, and many retailers let you pick a delivery date nearer Christmas, so ordering early doesn't mean it arrives early.

### Are there alcohol-free Christmas hampers?

Yes. Fortnum's Christmas Treat hamper (£120) has no alcohol listed, and Virginia Hayward has an alcohol-free box. Chocolate hampers like Hotel Chocolat's are also alcohol-free.

### Can I send a hamper with fresh cheese by post?

Yes, from specialists like Fine Food Specialist, which let you book a delivery date. Pick a day when someone will definitely be in, so the cheese doesn't sit on a doorstep.
